parsed.summary: Tracing the schematic against the specification, every functional element matches the intended design: the TPS2121 mux arbitrates +12V (IN1) and +5V (IN2) into VBUS, the AP63203WU buck has IN/EN on VBUS and FB tied directly to +3V3 (fixed output, no divider), the TPS1H200 high-side switch has VS=+12V, IN/DIAG_EN both on the GPIO1 heater net, CL tied to GND, and ~FAULT broken out to a test point only (not to the MCU). The three MAX31855 channels share SCK/SO with three independent CS nets that map to GPIO5/10/4/6/7 exactly as the firmware expects, each with a 1 uF decoupling cap; USB-C CC pull-downs are 5.1 k, ILIM is 51.1 k, SS is 10 nF, the buck inductor is 3.9 uH, and the WS2812 status LED is present. The only differences from the spec are reference-designator relabeling (e.g. MCU U1->U10, mux U5->U9, HSS U6->U3, buck U8->U11, TC U2/3/4->U1/4/6) and net names being auto-generated, neither of which changes behavior. I found no drawing-supported deviation.
